K1.why: Fact then the action in one line, with the auxiliary dropped as a banner does so it fits 30 (29 visible with the number filled in); ਮੁਫ਼ਤ stands for the free cutlings as it does in speech; ਟੈਪ ਕਰੋ is the word Punjabi phone UI uses for tap.

M1.why: A Punjabi command puts the verb last, so the Mac command name is object then ਅਣਲਾਕ ਕਰੋ, the form of other Punjabi menu commands.

M2.why: M1 with the ellipsis character because the button opens a window.

M3.why: A row label is a noun phrase; the item word from the vocabulary.

M4.why: A compact pair reads the same in Punjabi; numbers stay positional.

M5.why: A state with ਹੈ, which carries no gender ending.

M6.s: ਇੱਕੋ ਖਰੀਦ ਕਟਲਿੰਗ ਨੂੰ iPhone, iPad ਅਤੇ Mac 'ਤੇ ਅਣਲਾਕ ਕਰ ਦਿੰਦੀ ਹੈ।
M6.back: one-same purchase Cutling to iPhone, iPad and Mac on unlock do gives is.
M6.why: The purchase is the subject, so the verb agrees with feminine ਖਰੀਦ; the device list matches S8.

M7.s: ਇਸ Apple Account ਨਾਲ iPhone, iPad ਅਤੇ Mac 'ਤੇ ਅਣਲਾਕ ਹੈ।

M7.why: No subject needed under the Cutling section; ਅਣਲਾਕ ਹੈ as in M5.

M8.s: ਤੁਸੀਂ ਕਟਲਿੰਗ ਮੁਫ਼ਤ ਹੋਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਖਰੀਦਿਆ ਸੀ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਇਹ ਹਮੇਸ਼ਾ ਅਣਲਾਕ ਹੈ। ਸਾਥ ਦੇਣ ਲਈ ਧੰਨਵਾਦ।

M8.why: ਸਾਥ ਦੇਣ ਲਈ ਧੰਨਵਾਦ (thanks for standing with us) thanks an early buyer the way a person would; ਖਰੀਦਿਆ agrees with the object, as the Punjabi transitive past does.
